featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Review broadside source matches plus orbit stress views; each critical failure blocks the pass.

perPassLayerGates._rationale: The flat 0.9 threshold across all five layers is unsatisfiable before the material pass: buildPasses[0] is defined as 'map-stripped macro silhouette and camera framing' while materialSurface and lightingCamera belong to buildPasses[3] and [5]. Under the flat rule no early pass can ever close. Each build pass therefore gates on the layers it is responsible for; the other layers are still SCORED and recorded every pass so regressions stay visible.

perRegionConfidence._basis: Every entry states what was MEASURED and what remains inference. 'silhouetteXY' is what the two broadside plates can establish; 'depthZ' is what they structurally cannot. Where the 3D reference set was used instead, the file is named. Where nothing settles it, the entry says so rather than carrying a number.

barrel.note: Constant diameter and blunt crown match both plates to 0.1-0.2 mask rows. Axis raised to 0.6860 from a held-top-edge sweep.

barrel-front-sight-block.note: Height and station measured on both plates. DEPTH IS INFERRED from ref3d-09; a broadside cannot show it.

muzzle.note: Crown profile measured. The bore's visible mouth is partly eroded from the reference mask (dark on black), so its last column is not trustworthy evidence.

scope-objective.note: Long continuous flare confirmed on BOTH plates against a 3D reading that said otherwise. Bell radius 0.2214 is a LOWER BOUND: the reference profile was still rising when black objective glass eroded it out of the mask at the same column on both plates.

scope-rings.note: Bridge width measured at 4 mask columns on both plates. Clamp depth in Z, saddle cross-section and screw form are NOT establishable from any broadside.

scope-turret.note: Hourglass confirmed by two independent methods: a column-width scan of both plates and a read of the 3D set. Cap-to-housing height ratio is LOW confidence - the only view showing it is foreshortened.

bolt-knob.note: UNRESOLVED. The reference's visible edge sits 0.034 world past the authored knob edge, but the plates cannot distinguish an undersized knob from a shallower stock cutout. Both explanations fit equally. Not tuned on a tie.

bolt-handle-shank.note: The shank never separates from the guard/stock silhouette on either plate, so its authored ~39 degree angle and 2.96-row thickness have NO independent 2D confirmation.

trigger-blade.note: Present at the correct size - reference 0.78-2.34 mask rows at cols 62-64, render comparable. Its faint appearance on the beauty render is CONTRAST, not missing geometry. Station is roughly one column off and a straight translation regressed the gate.

bipod-legs.note: Reach and rod thickness match both plates within noise; an earlier 'thicker and shorter' claim was retracted on measurement. Legs are co-planar when folded (3D set, medium confidence - one file conflicts and was outweighed by two mutually consistent true broadsides).

bipod-springs.note: The 3D set gives a coil-to-rod outer-diameter ratio of 2-2.5x where this model builds 1.11x. External free-standing coil confirmed correct as authored.

crown-skull-decal.note: Projected from the reference's own pixels. Width matches exactly at 7.1 mask columns, top edge within 0.2 rows. Bottom edge 1.0-1.3 rows short with four causes tested and eliminated; cause unknown.

shell-finish.note: Medusa artwork projected through the capture camera onto stock and receiver. Foreground-masked albedo reads (23.9,32.4,43.7) against the reference's (21.2,34.5,48.9). Painted surfaces beyond those two are not yet panelled.

hidden-internals.note: Two opposing broadsides plus a 3D set with NO top-down view. Rail width in plan, bipod leg spread in plan, receiver underside and all internal action geometry are unestablished by any supplied reference.

scope-turret-side.note: Windage knob. Diameter is HIGH confidence: ref-02 views it down its own axis so its diameters are unforeshortened, giving hex across-flats 0.86 of the tube diameter (80px vs 93px). Axial protrusion 0.152 is MEDIUM-HIGH: measured on ref-04 along the knob's top edge, de-foreshortened by the end face's own 95:220 aspect (theta ~25.5 deg). The stepped stack (boss / stem / flat-topped hex cap / recessed socket) is confirmed by both views independently. depthZ is unusually high for this build because this part's axis points along the plates' view direction, so ref-02's axial view measures exactly what the plates cannot.

undetermined.scope-turret-side-stem.radius: The hex cap occludes the stem in ref-04 and hides it completely in ref-02's axial view. Authored at 0.088, just under the hex across-flats, so it stays hidden exactly as both references show. Any value from 0 to 0.093 fits the evidence equally well; this is a placement that cannot be falsified by the supplied views, not a measurement.
